identity.name: CodeMind-Llama3-8B-unsloth_v2-merged
identity.summary: The model is a Llama-based text-generation model that was trained with Unsloth and Hugging Face's TRL library.

possible_risks.description: Models might generate code that causes harm or unintentionally affects other systems.
possible_risks.justification: Fine-tuned on LeetCode_Python_Solutions and generates code, so it may produce code that causes harm or unintended effects.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card names the dataset but provides no documentation of its collection, curation, or filtering, so dataset details are insufficiently documented.

possible_risks.description: The content of the training data used for generating the model's output is not accessible.
possible_risks.justification: The card does not provide access to the training data content, so outputs cannot be traced to specific training examples.

possible_risks.description: Poor model accuracy occurs when a model's performance is insufficient to the task it was designed for. Low accuracy might occur if the model is not correctly engineered, or if the model's expected inputs change.
possible_risks.justification: The card reports no evaluation results for the fine-tuned checkpoint, so its accuracy on code-generation tasks is unverified.

specifications.model_size: 15.0 GiB of safetensors weights (16,060,556,376 bytes) in BF16

training_context.training_data: The model was fine-tuned on the LimYeri/LeetCode_Python_Solutions dataset.
